video_title: LeBron  to the Dubs? Sam Amick on the Masterful Free Agency Drama

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green's public criticism of Bam Adebayo's off-court punch
quotes.excerpt: Draymond Green is a talented communicator and watching his perspective on his pod is interesting.

text_blocks.speaker: Adam Copeland
text_blocks.text: Do you think it is unfair that Draymond Green was persecuted harder publicly than it seems like Bam Adebayo has been for the off-court punch?

text_blocks.speaker: Sam Amick
text_blocks.text: Draymond Green is a talented communicator and watching his perspective on his pod is interesting. Not to get in the weeds too much, but you guys know because you are in the media, if you do four hours of radio by yourself, that is tougher than with a partner. Draymond sits up there a lot of times by himself trying to communicate how he sees things and then he just looks at that camera and without any hesitation goes in on a guy like Udonis Haslem who was one of the baddest dudes I would argue in the history of the game.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Lack of video evidence in the Draymond Green incident
quotes.excerpt: The most obvious difference to this point, and I think this could change, is that we don't have video.
quotes.quote: The most obvious difference to this point, and I think this could change, is that we don't have video. When that story broke with Draymond Green, it was a big deal, and you did instantly hear about Jordan Poole getting absolutely leveled. This one is like, we were told by two people who were in the room that he absolutely punched him, but it was like, it didn't really connect. Other people are like, maybe more of a mush of the face. But the video is the biggest thing and I am curious if TMZ is doing I am sure what they do, which is trying to cut a check to get that video.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Uncertainty surrounding LeBron James's free agency destination
quotes.excerpt: I have had Miami tell me it is Cleveland, I have had Cleveland tell me it is Miami.
quotes.quote: The whole negotiation process or information process has been unprecedented. Is there been any change in your mind about the trajectory or path of where this is going? I am not obligated to update things every two days like some of those guys are. And if I was, I would have been riding the same roller coaster they were. I have had Miami tell me it is Cleveland, I have had Cleveland tell me it is Miami, and the Warriors have seemingly had a lot of pessimism recently.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson's comments on LeBron James's status
quotes.excerpt: Kenny Atkinson just openly talking on SiriusXM Radio about them being in the running for maybe the best player.
quotes.quote: The most telling behavior thing publicly is Kenny Atkinson just openly talking on SiriusXM Radio about them being in the running for maybe the best player of all time. And his energy, he is going to take some flak from Cavs fans if they don't get him. He was maybe a little over his skis there and I am not sure if that is a sign of optimism from him or something else, but yeah, I am not sure which way it is going to go.

quotes.speaker: Rod Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Golden State Warriors as a viable destination for LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: They are an attractive spot for LeBron James, not just in terms of playing with Stephen Curry and the Draymond Green.
quotes.quote: They are an attractive spot for LeBron James, not just in terms of playing with Stephen Curry and the Draymond Green. There has to be more than just Stephen Curry and Draymond Green. There has got to be an Anthony Davis or something. But putting that aside for a second, you can play good, I think meaningful basketball with Stephen Curry and the Golden State Warriors and also not disrupt much of your home life. So to me, not only just having the ability to play with Stephen Curry and possibly others, but just from a distance standpoint, the Warriors seem to be the smart play in that regard to not disrupt much of your home life.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Lack of an indisputable basketball fit for LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: I am on the lookout for like an indisputable basketball champion in terms of the fit.
quotes.quote: I am on the lookout for like an indisputable basketball champion in terms of the fit. And I don't know that there is one. Cleveland showed all kinds of warts in the playoffs. Miami is, and I am putting it this way because these are the Warriors competitors, but like the Heat, I saw Danny Green the other day, a dude who I know is a role player, but a guy who knows something about winning a ring, literally saying he doesn't think Miami is going to be in the top six in the East. So LeBron James would be a strange fit in Miami.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's potential fit in Minnesota or Denver
quotes.excerpt: The best basketball fits really are the places where people kind of unofficially don't expect LeBron James to go.
quotes.quote: The best basketball fits really are the places where people kind of unofficially don't expect LeBron James to go, which is Minnesota and Denver. And then to your point about just life in general and the convenience of being in the Bay and Northern California versus going out East anywhere, is everything you hit on. And I think that is why it is made for such an interesting situation because if you then, if you get into the narrative thing, which I think is worth exploring because LeBron James is always mindful of his own narrative, I can't get enough of that conversation.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala's comments on LeBron James and the Warriors
quotes.excerpt: Andre Iguodala talked about how essentially if Stephen Curry can convince LeBron James to come, that it elevates him.
quotes.quote: I went to the Players Association meeting in Vegas where Andre Iguodala spoke, I think maybe for the first time as president of the union. He hasn't done any media. But somebody caught him afterwards and did an interview where Andre Iguodala talked about how essentially if Stephen Curry can convince LeBron James to come, that it elevates him in the GOAT conversation because you had Kevin Durant chasing your team, you had LeBron James. And what cracked me up is how Warriors fans were basically like, Draymond, shut up man, that is not helping. That is not going to make LeBron James want to come.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA free agency drama compared to other league scandals
quotes.excerpt: This pales in comparison to gambling scandals and Kawhi Leonard controversies and all of the above.
quotes.quote: This pales in comparison to gambling scandals and Kawhi Leonard controversies and all of the above. This to me, even I would equate it to, in our company, we certainly have data where we have a very good sense of when people are interested in engaged in NBA coverage and when they are not. So I think Adam Silver's response would be, listen, it is pretty tough to keep the public's attention beyond the first week in July. So in that regard, I don't think the NBA is upset about this. You are talking about the league.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: The nature of NBA free agency rumors and agent tactics
quotes.excerpt: There is a sentiment from other agents, from other camps, if you will, that it is all a little bit silly.
quotes.quote: When I was in Vegas, and I just got home yesterday, there is a sentiment from other agents, from other camps, if you will, that it is all a little bit silly. And it is fascinating, it is compelling, but it is also the product of at this point in the off-season, nobody else being available. There was a clip the other day, Jaylen Brown talking to the influencer Speed about the Sixers. And he says, Speed says, man, this is going to be lit, it is Jaylen Brown and he mentioned a player who wasn't on their team anymore. I am envisioning the GMs making mistakes like that on their voice notes.
